description:
Get the mix ci alias (compile --warnings-as-errors, format, test, credo --strict, dialyzer, ex_dna --max-clones 0, reach.check) passing without blanket suppressions.

Split: (a) truthful fixes (dialyzer specs, shared helper for the clone, genuine complexity extractions), (b) calibrated thresholds and site-level false-positive suppressions, each justified by an ADR so the decision can be revisited.

Current state: compile/format/test/reach pass; credo, dialyzer and ex_dna fail. Per-case investigation is complete (see children).
title: Make mix ci green honestly (dialyzer, ex_dna, credo) and document out-of-bounds decisions
